scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev:local" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.setup:supabase: npm run setup && cd backend && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup:local: npm run setup && cd backend && npm run setup:local
